headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.12
summary: Every animated background now has its own advanced options, and a new Rain effect brings wind, clouds, and lightning to the lineup.

items.text: Added per-effect advanced options — speed, density, layer and ring counts, pool usage — edited with sliders under the effect picker and applied to the running background instantly.
New Rain effect: adjustable wind strength and direction, swaying or wind-blown clouds, drop density, and lightning strikes with an adjustable chance (lower means rarer).
The options system now supports toggles and dropdown choices alongside percent sliders.
Vietnamese labels for the advanced options and the Rain effect.
